summary.name: Silhouette Illustration, in the Drawing and Illustration category. The label was normalized from a source description of a flat black silhouette.
summary.visualIdentity: Communicates through recognizable outlines, poses, and negative space using a limited set of solid colors. Clear depth layers are used, and details may be omitted when the silhouette still reads. Limbs stay separated and contrast stays sufficient through movement.
summary.suitableUses: The source states the style is strong alone for symbolic narratives, and its combination guidance lists storytelling intros and ambient scenes. Inferred suitability includes chaptered explanatory narratives where silhouettes carry meaning without fine detail.
summary.limitations: Overlapping silhouettes, gradient fills, and fast moves are listed as things to avoid. Text should not sit over figures, and titles belong in negative space. Two-color contrast checks do not guarantee readability over textures or video. Simulated appearance is not evidence of physical production.
summary.palette: These are suggested tokens, since no approved palette was supplied: background #F5E9CF, foreground #253442, and accent_1 #647F81. Gradients are disabled. Foreground on background measures 10.579:1, meeting the 4.5 normal-text target. Accent on background measures 3.563:1, so it is decorative only. Task-supplied exact colors override these suggestions.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Use smooth, coherent movement where it serves the action, and preserve deliberate cuts, impacts, and reading holds. Automatic springs, bounce, and extra in-between poses are not added by default. Video is driven by composition time, while interactive delivery may use scroll progress with a reduced-motion fallback. Optional motion-012 and motion-015 apply only when scene content supports them.
summary.audio: The source sets no mandatory audio layer. Options include background music, voiceover, sound effects, ambience, or silence, chosen according to topic and audience. User audio requirements take priority. Speech must stay intelligible without competing vocals, and no audio assets are supplied.
summary.assetRequirements: Filled contours and designed pose groups need explicit pivots. Foreground and background should be separated with masks and consistent luminance. Fonts and assets must be preloaded and randomness seeded. Paper.js is optional for compound paths and holes, and tldraw is optional for authoring.
summary.combinations: Style-101 adds depth-layer planes with slow movement and stable outlines. Style-093 adds kinetic titles placed in negative space at a slow rhythm. Both pairings require primary-palette tones only, separated limbs, and no overlapping silhouettes. Gradients and fast moves should be avoided.
summary.productionApproach: The style renderer is SVG, with optional Paper.js for geometry. The motion engine is GSAP, with optional Motion for DOM or SVG layers. HyperFrames is the default pipeline for assembly, timing, and export. Remotion is a fallback only when HyperFrames is unavailable or a verified limitation exists. Final checks cover decoded frames, audio sync, loop seams, and dimensions.
